summary: Platform-independent modules ansible.netcommon.cli_command and cli_config replace platform-specific config/command modules to cut tasks and conditionals; they require the network_cli connection.
questions: How can I simplify playbooks for multiple network vendors?
Which connection do cli_command and cli_config need?

answer_card.title: Platform-independent network modules
answer_card.answer_md: Use `ansible.netcommon.cli_command` and `ansible.netcommon.cli_config` instead of `eos_config`, `ios_config`, `junos_config`, etc. Fewer tasks and fewer `when` conditions. They require the `ansible.netcommon.network_cli` connection.
